question: Which among the following Vitamins plays an essential role in vision?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin A:-**

 
 
• It​ plays an essential role in** vision **as it helps to maintain a **healthy retina.**
 
• It also helps in the production of a protein called** rhodopsin,** which enables the** retina to absorb light.**
 
• **Vitamin A** deficiency can lead to **night blindness **and other eye problems. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin C **is commonly found in fruits such as** oranges, strawberries, and kiwis, and vegetables** such as broccoli, bell peppers, and tomatoes.
 
• **Vitamin B1** is commonly found in foods such as** whole grains, meat, fish, and beans.**
 
• **Vitamin D** is commonly found in foods such as **fatty fish, egg yolks, and fortified dairy products,** and can also be synthesized by the body through exposure to sunlight.
